hypotheses.statement: Demand outstripped supply and pricing power rose (gross margin expanded with revenue)
hypotheses.test: Gross margin change alongside revenue (>= 2 pts)
hypotheses.detail: Margin moved with revenue - consistent with pricing power / mix.

hypotheses.statement: Sales ran ahead of inventory (demand-led growth)
hypotheses.test: Inventory growth vs revenue growth (10-pt gap)

hypotheses.statement: Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)
hypotheses.test: Operating income % change vs revenue % change

answer.summary: Nvidia's revenue rose in FY2024: $26.97B -> $60.92B (+125.9%). The evidence points mainly to (1) demand outstripped supply and pricing power rose (gross margin expanded with revenue); (2) sales ran ahead of inventory (demand-led growth); (3) operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue).

confidence.label: High
confidence.rationale: 3 of 3 hypotheses supported; supported drivers cover ~100% of the move; 88% of queries returned data; 1 context corroborations.

caveats: Values are the latest filed (as-restated) figures per period; XBRL tags vary by company and year.
